name: render
summary: write Talos machine configs, talosconfig and kubeconfig from TalosCluster and TalosNode files (touches no machine)

flags.name: credentials-ttl
flags.usage: lifetime of the admin talosconfig and kubeconfig (at most 720h); they cannot be revoked short of a CA rotation

flags.name: dir
flags.usage: directory with TalosCluster/TalosNode (and patch ConfigMap) manifests (required)

flags.name: image-factory
flags.usage: image factory host the installer image is named on

flags.name: no-credentials
flags.usage: write the node configs only, no admin talosconfig or kubeconfig

flags.name: out
flags.usage: output directory: <node>.yaml per node, talosconfig, kubeconfig

flags.name: register
flags.usage: tell the image factory about each schematic (needs network); off computes ids offline

flags.name: secrets
flags.usage: secrets bundle from talosctl gen secrets, or - for stdin (required)
